title: cost.json — agent self-reported spend record
description: What the agent writes per prompts/review.md and report --cost rolls up. One object per run, or an array when a bundle was reviewed more than once. The script only sums — it never prices: effort defaults to standard when missing or unknown, records without models still count as runs but not as runs_with_cost, every `models[]` entry must name its model — the name is what attribution reads, and the rollup sums all of them into one total rather than reporting per model, absent/unreadable records contribute zeros and never fail. Per-chunk records (chunks/<name>.cost.json) share this shape. Two readers treat unknown keys differently, and this schema allows them for both. Aggregators — the rollup, the group estimate, the receipt — read the fields they know and ignore the rest, so a newer writer's extra field never voids history. Certification of lens evidence is version-scoped: a record offered as schema_version "2" may carry only the top-level fields v2 defines, and an extra one refuses that record by name until it is removed or a version that defines it is declared. A record bound to the run at a different version refuses as unsupported rather than being re-read as v2.

effort.description: Run tier; missing or unknown values roll up as standard.

models.description: One entry per model that generated tokens: the synthesizer first, then each lens.

est_usd.description: The agent's own math from its price sheet, null when prices are unknown — never guessed.

cache_read_input_tokens.description: Input tokens served from cache; a subset of input_tokens, never an addition. Absent or null reads as unknown, never zero.

cache_creation_input_tokens.description: Input tokens spent writing the cache; a subset of input_tokens, never an addition. Absent or null reads as unknown, never zero.
